environment: LOCAL isolated PGlite; synthetic invoices only

cases.name: Preview validates original rounded amounts without writing any business or audit rows
Apply requires the exact reviewed source and warehouse digest
Repeated and concurrent imports retain exactly four records
A changed duplicate rejects and rolls back the whole batch, including preceding new invoices
Bad totals, incomplete payments, duplicate invoice keys, traversal and invalid PNG bytes fail before persistence
Role matrix and regional warehouse scope protect metadata, private image bytes and imports
Search and aggregate totals follow the same access scope and metadata has no raw bytes
Database prevents rewriting or deleting imported invoices; backup checks actual image hashes
SELECT/INSERT-only runtime imports and locks without UPDATE/DELETE privilege
Stale, disabled and forged role principals cannot read or import
